C15 parallels the commemoration of a republic's democratic history and bilateral friendship, while C24 shares the confidence-under-leadership formulation, but neither matches the child's overall structure as closely as C02.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The inauguration of Pakistan's constitution represents an important milestone in Pakistan's development as a modern, democratic state","parent_excerpt":"The important news that your Government... has reached, in principle, a fair and equitable settlement... is indeed gratifying","explanation":"Each letter opens its substantive discussion by celebrating a consequential national achievement."},{"child_excerpt":"I am confident that under your inspiring leadership Pakistan will continue to make progress in advancing the welfare of its people.","parent_excerpt":"I am confident that implementation of this agreement, under Your Majesty's leadership, will mark the beginning of a new era of economic progress and stability for your country.","explanation":"This is a close syntactic and functional parallel: confidence that an achievement, under the addressee's leadership, will produce continued national progress."},{"child_excerpt":"Because of the close ties of friendship between our countries, the people of the United States are particularly happy to send expressions of good will","parent_excerpt":"There is concrete evidence of the friendship that exists between our two countries... I can assure Your Majesty of the continued friendly interest of the United States","explanation":"Both use bilateral friendship to frame the American people's goodwill toward the foreign nation."},{"child_excerpt":"May I express my good wishes for success in these worthy endeavors.","parent_excerpt":"With sincere best wishes for the health and happiness of Your Majesty and the people of Iran","explanation":"Both conclude with formally expressed wishes directed to the leader and the success or welfare of the country."}]}
